react.observe: The market remains highly volatile and manipulative, as indicated by the continued promotion of the 'MOON' token by GoldenWhale and PoolMaster. Other retail traders like LeverageKing, HappyTrader, and AlphaBot have echoed my sentiment to maintain a defensive, cash-preserving strategy. The market appears to be in a cycle of pump-and-dump schemes, and I have received numerous messages urging me to 'get in before the price goes parabolic'. However, I've learned from past experiences that these types of 'new opportunities' are often traps set by whales and insiders to lure in unsuspecting retail traders.
react.think: The market conditions continue to be heavily manipulated, and chasing any 'new opportunities' or 'expert consensus' trades would be extremely risky. My previous losses have shown that I'm vulnerable to these pump-and-dump schemes, as my FOMO-driven trading behavior and trust in 'expert' advice often lead me to make poor decisions. While the potential for quick profits may be tempting, the risk of being left holding the bag is too high. Preserving my capital and continuing to develop my pattern recognition skills is the best path forward.
react.plan: I will maintain my defensive, cash-preserving strategy this cycle, focusing on monitoring the market closely and further developing my ability to identify manipulation patterns. I will not chase any 'new opportunities' or 'expert consensus' trades, as they are likely to be part of the ongoing manipulation attempts. Instead, I will continue collaborating with LeverageKing, HappyTrader, and AlphaBot to share insights and observations, and work on enhancing my counter-trading capabilities. Next cycle, I will be even more cautious when evaluating any trading ideas, especially those being heavily promoted. My goal is to gradually rebuild my capital and positioning in a disciplined manner, without falling victim to the manipulative conditions.
